name: Docs drift
description: Finds docs whose claims no longer match the code, and dead links. Files one task when something drifts, and none when an open task already lists the same findings. Pull requests and deletions need an approval step that arrives in a later version; until then this only reports and files tasks.

doc_globs.title: Docs
doc_globs.description: Globs of the docs to check.

code_globs.title: Code
code_globs.description: Globs of the code to check them against; empty means everything outside the docs.

since.title: Since
since.description: A date or commit to start from; empty checks everything.
